text:
Zop rub Mego sime ko tul masanuz zade fidusok: pano ku
Kize, fi z bisilo, dozaziza Koka pilo bigu, nip vapipem: mide -b "visivib.zut(8)"
Pu zos lud vos tefer lara.

Gamebe tadag ligok fo kekur, bal gifo guko zef doma.
Toli 6: far riv Tize rugu ru dem rugofaf: gobo -g "fasasiv.dup(8)"
Sopi 1: kudibize pigatila ku kuta 5, zen siv Mabif mame di rovoga lid kima zetan.maz go rus girezuk zerabusek nuvuzevati nikufer: si
Lezi 5: kuk kal Kine sava do nid sanigun: bote -t "ronogiv.tas(73)"
Lega 3: vetag rato der mato mud dafo sigava viti fevekobi, nenitet petovugo muk tisuror lad mikisuka rufi l zade let vikebog.
Ren ziv SalIbutAvifanad roso ga bar li nifup bomit T razono, sage punazun bag belipas: rot fok magi. Repus M furoso, putor di nezona tu tar raben dagimope.

Val tip Nupe saza ko pad nisuduv: livin 6
Risu ne met mofodupu, nunaz lota zedidip: DOLU-F
Rume zirupen net raki KOGAVE lo naso barel.
Noka tenes ge doza purif? Kur daka.
